name: Alexandr Wang
current_role: Chief AI Officer of Meta and head of Meta Superintelligence Labs (since June 2025)
summary: Alexandr Wang left MIT to co-found the AI data company Scale AI in 2016, becoming the world's youngest self-made billionaire; Scale sold data-labeling services widely, including to the U.S. military. In January 2025 he ran a full-page open letter urging Trump to "win the AI war" with China. In June 2025 Meta bought 49% of Scale for about $14.3 billion and made Wang its first chief AI officer.
